headline: SSD-LLaMA reports trillion-parameter MoE inference on a single RTX 5090
summary: The SSD-LLaMA preprint describes an SSD-to-RAM-to-VRAM expert-delivery system with a three-tier cache and CPU–GPU execution placement for MoE inference. On a stated consumer testbed with one RTX 5090, 16 GB host DRAM and a 4 TB NVMe SSD, the authors report running a 2.8T-parameter Kimi-K3 at 1.217 prefill tokens/s and 0.465 decode tokens/s. Section 5.4 reports baseline-specific throughput gains, while the abstract and conclusion give different aggregate ranges; the exact mapping is unresolved. These are paper-reported measurements, not an independent reproduction.
